指标.原句: As seen in Figure 3a, the galvanostatic cycling behavior of coin cells (E/S = 12 µL mg-1) with and without NH4TFA is quite similar, generally maintaining between 800 and 900 mA h g-1 over the course of 100 cycles.
Most notably, the cell containing NH4TFA does exhibit slightly superior kinetic behavior, with a lower overpotential on the order of 40 mV seen during discharge.
From a capacity standpoint, the NH4TFA additive enables a capacity of 930 mA h g-1 compared to 250 mA h g-1 for the control cell, a sizeable 370% improvement.

As seen in the voltage profile in Figure 7a, the NH4TFA- optimized electrolyte formulation slightly outperforms the other formulations at 25 °C, achieving capacities that are 13 and 9% higher than, respectively, the control and LiTFA- containing electrolytes.
